title: Phishing Detective: Suspicious Invoice
simulation_notice: This is a fictional training simulation. No message, sender, link or organisation shown here is real.
briefing: You are helping the Nexus Corporation finance team review an unexpected invoice notification. Examine the message and identify the warning signs before choosing a safe response.

email.subject: FINAL NOTICE: Invoice NC-2048 requires immediate payment
body: Our records show invoice NC-2048 is overdue. Payment must be completed within two hours to avoid service suspension.
Review the invoice using the address below. If you have questions, reply directly to this message.
email.attachment_label: No attachment is provided in this simulation.

indicators.label: The sender domain is not independently verified as belonging to Nexus Corporation.
The reply-to address uses a different external domain.
The message pressures the recipient to act within two hours.
The invoice is unexpected and should be verified independently.
The displayed invoice link uses an unverified domain.
The message contains a specific invoice reference number. This fact alone is not suspicious.
The message is addressed to the Finance Team. A team greeting alone is not suspicious.
The message arrived at 09:14. The time alone is not suspicious.

response_options.label: Open the link and pay immediately to avoid suspension.
Reply to the email and ask whether the invoice is genuine.
Do not interact with the message. Verify through a known official channel and report it using the organisation's approved process.
Forward the message to a colleague and ask them to open the link.

learning_objectives: Recognise sender and reply-to domain inconsistencies.
Choose an independent verification and reporting response.
